rows.feature: New, open, save, save as, close subtitles
rows.text: A failed save never leaves half a file, and lines other programs added are kept byte for byte.
rows.where: File › Open subtitles…, Save, Save as…, Close tab

rows.feature: Recent subtitles, video, audio, keyframes, timecodes
rows.where: File › Recently opened subtitles; Video › Recently opened videos, keyframes, timecodes; Audio › Recently opened audio

rows.feature: Open SRT, MicroDVD, SSA, plain text
rows.text: Also opens MPL2, TMPlayer, LRC, TTML, KRC/QRC lyrics and YouTube srv3, and reads the format from the content, not the extension.
rows.where: File › Open subtitles…; File › Import lyrics…

rows.feature: Open MPEG-4 Streaming Text (TTXT)
rows.text: TTXT files don't open; convert them with MP4Box or ffmpeg first.

rows.feature: Plain text import options (actor separator, comment starter, blank lines)
rows.text: Also keeps blank lines as comment lines if you like, previews the lines as you change the options, and adds them to the open file or a new one.

rows.feature: Open subtitles from the video (MKV tracks), compressed tracks included
Open with a chosen charset, and legacy charsets
rows.text: A banner names the encoding HikariSub found in a file that isn't UTF-8, and Reopen with encoding… reads it in any of 17 encodings; it saves as UTF-8.

rows.feature: Script properties (credits, resolution, LayoutRes, YCbCr matrix, wrap style, scale border)
rows.text: Also sets colliding lines, and can write your credits into every file on save.

rows.feature: Script properties: Synch point and Update details fields
rows.text: The window has no Synch point or Update details field.

rows.feature: Attachments manager (attach and extract fonts and graphics)
rows.text: There's no window to attach or extract files; attached fonts are only read for drawing.

rows.feature: Prompt before loading scripts a subtitle file names
rows.where: A bar asks before loading the file's scripts

rows.feature: Linked media: load associated files, report missing ones
rows.where: The association bar: "Linked files not found:"

rows.feature: Save UI state in the subtitle file
Keep `[Aegisub Extradata]` (folds, perspective plane) through load and save
Columns, CPS, show or hide columns
rows.text: Empty columns hide themselves, and a Wraps column.

rows.feature: CPS warning and line-length thresholds you can set
rows.text: Also a limit on the number of lines, and a file can keep its own limits.
rows.where: File › Settings › Grid › Counting; Subtitles › Script properties › Reading limits

rows.feature: Next and previous line, next line creating one at the end
Select all, select lines visible on the video
rows.where: Ctrl+A in the Grid; Grid › Select lines visible on video

rows.feature: Insert before or after, also at video time
rows.text: Also at the video frame's time.
rows.where: Grid › Insert › Before, After, at video time, at video frame time

rows.feature: Copy, cut, paste, delete, duplicate lines
rows.where: Grid › Cut, Copy, Paste, Duplicate, Delete

rows.feature: Paste lines over (choose which fields)
rows.where: Grid › Paste special › Copy columns, Paste columns

rows.feature: Swap two lines
Move lines up or down one row
rows.text: There's no command to move lines up or down a row.

rows.feature: Sort all or selected lines by start, end, style, actor, effect, layer
rows.text: Also by text and by text without tags (from the fork, FA1 §2a).
rows.where: Edit › Sort all lines, Sort selected lines

rows.feature: Tag hiding: show, hide, simplify, cycle
rows.text: There's no command that cycles between the modes; View › Hide tags in the Grid swaps each block for ☀, and tags vanish only if that replacement is set to nothing in Settings.
rows.where: View › Hide tags in the Grid

rows.feature: Grid highlights the lines on the current frame
rows.text: The Grid doesn't mark the lines shown at the video frame.

rows.feature: Line folding (arch1t3cht's fork)
rows.text: Folds convert to line groups, which nest, and plain folds are kept on save.
rows.where: Grid › Convert Aegisub folds to line groups

rows.feature: Smooth touchpad scrolling
Bold, italic, underline, strikeout, font, the four colours
rows.text: Works on the selected text and restores the style after it; up to 20 tag buttons of your own.

rows.feature: Colour picker with screen dropper, RGB, HSL, HSV, recent colours
Syntax highlighting, tag help while typing
rows.where: Line editor; type `\` for the tag list

rows.feature: Drawing and clip coordinates in alternating colours; mixin lines as templates
Insert hard space `\h`; Shift+Enter inserts `\n` (setting)
rows.where: Edit › Insert hard space; Settings › Editing

rows.feature: Times past 10 hours
Show times or frames in the fields
Split lines before or after the current frame
Split at the text cursor (estimate times, keep times, at the video frame)
rows.text: Nothing splits a line at the text cursor.

rows.feature: Join lines: concatenate, keep first
rows.text: Also keep last, and F4/F5 join with the line before or after.
rows.where: Grid › Join › Join, Keep first, Keep last

rows.feature: Join lines as karaoke
rows.text: There's no join that turns each line into a `\k` syllable.

rows.feature: Split lines by karaoke syllables
rows.text: No split by syllable; Split › At tag blocks folds `\k` syllables into one delay instead.

rows.feature: Recombine lines that were split and merged
rows.text: There's no recombine command; it's an old workflow, and a Lua script can do it.

rows.feature: Show Original pane, Revert, Insert Original
rows.text: Esc drops an unapplied draft, but there's no pane with the line as it was and no Insert Original.

rows.feature: Clear text, or clear text but keep the tags
rows.text: Delete text empties the whole text; nothing keeps the tags.

rows.feature: Undo and redo
rows.text: A History window jumps to any step, and Undo to last save.
rows.where: Edit › Undo, Redo, Undo to last save, History

rows.feature: Thesaurus in the text's right-click menu
rows.text: Right-click offers spelling and grammar only; a Suggest synonyms AI action is planned.

rows.feature: Open audio, from video, close; audio track choice
rows.text: Reload audio keeps the place and track; decoded audio is cached on disk.
rows.where: Audio › Open audio…, Open audio from video, Close audio, Reload audio

rows.feature: Blank or noise audio for testing
rows.text: There's no noise audio and no standalone blank audio; a dummy video brings silent audio.

rows.feature: Waveform and spectrum display
rows.text: A Speech spectrum mode.
rows.where: Audio panel buttons: Spectrum mode, Speech

rows.feature: Spectrum with log power and log frequency mapping
rows.text: Speech mode maps frequency non-linearly, but power stays linear and there's no choice of curve.

rows.feature: Play selection, line, toggle, stop; 500 ms before, after, first, last; to the end
rows.text: Also play around a marker, and slower playback at 25 to 75% with the pitch kept.

rows.feature: Commit, commit and next, commit and stay; auto commit, auto next
Commit and reset the next line to the default timing
rows.text: There's no commit that resets the next line's times.

rows.feature: Go to selection, its start, its end; scroll left and right; auto scroll
Horizontal and vertical zoom, volume
Link vertical zoom and volume sliders
rows.where: Audio panel: Link the volume and stretch sliders

rows.feature: Save an audio clip of the line
rows.text: Audio can't be saved to a file.

rows.feature: Video position marker in the audio, snapping to frame middles
Audio display shows inactive lines (none, previous, previous and next, all)
Mono playback
rows.text: Play in mono covers the audio panel and editing playback, not general video playback.
rows.where: Settings › Audio › Playback › Play in mono

rows.feature: Audio player and device choice
rows.text: Playback moves to the default device when yours is unplugged, and back when it returns.

rows.feature: Snap to keyframes and other lines while dragging
Medusa mode: a toggle that makes the timing keys work anywhere
rows.text: There's no toggle; audio keys work over the Audio panel and the Grid, and numpad keys in text fields are a setting.

rows.feature: Lead-in, lead-out, both, for selected lines
rows.text: Remove lead-in and lead-out too, and adding stops at the neighbour.
rows.where: Subtitles › Timing helpers › Add lead-in, Remove lead-in, Add lead-out, Remove lead-out

rows.feature: Lengthen or shorten the line or syllable by keys, and shift what follows
rows.text: Only one-frame start and end moves (with a video) and right-drag of syllables.
rows.where: Subtitles › Timing helpers › Move start/end one frame earlier/later

rows.feature: Next or previous line or syllable
Make times continuous (change start or end)
Snap start or end to the video frame
rows.text: A joined neighbour stays joined.
rows.where: Video › Set start time from video, Set end time from video

rows.feature: Shift the selection so the active line starts at the current frame
rows.text: Also end at video, and all following lines.
rows.where: Video › Shift by frames to video

rows.feature: Snap to scene: start and end to the keyframes around the current frame
rows.text: Keyframe snaps move one edge at a time; nothing sets both from the video frame.

rows.feature: Shift times by time or frames, forward or back, chosen lines and times
rows.text: Live preview, shift to the video or an audio mark, move tag times, centre within frames, presets.

rows.feature: Shift times history (Load from history)
rows.text: Presets and "last used" cover it.

rows.feature: Timing post-processor: lead-in, lead-out, continuity, keyframe snapping, styles
rows.text: Live preview, and a line-by-line assistant that says why each edge moved.
rows.where: Subtitles › Timing postprocessor…; Timing helpers › Timing assistant

rows.feature: Post-processor closes small overlaps (Max overlap)
rows.text: Close small gaps acts on gaps only.

rows.feature: Keyframes: open
Keyframes: save, or close and go back to the video's own
rows.text: Keyframes can be opened, not saved or closed.

rows.feature: Timecodes: open, save, close
rows.text: Also reads mkvmerge's v4 and `timestamp` headers.
rows.where: Video › Open timecodes…, Save timecodes…, Close timecodes

rows.feature: Kanji timer
rows.text: Every pair in one window, and it can write furigana readings and `#` multi-highlight syllables.

rows.feature: Karaoke mode in the audio display
rows.text: Auto split, tap to time, onset snap, `\k`/`\kf` switch.

rows.feature: Centre times within frames (arch1t3cht's script)
Open, close video; open audio with it
rows.text: Indexing runs in a strip with Cancel while the window stays usable; Reload video keeps the frame.
rows.where: Video › Open video…, Unload video, Reload video

rows.feature: Play, play line, stop
rows.where: Video › Play or pause; video right-click › Play, Stop

rows.feature: Step frames, keyframes, fast jumps
rows.where: Video › Go to previous frame, Go to next frame, Go to previous/next keyframe

rows.feature: Next or previous subtitle boundary
rows.text: No command steps the video to the next line start or end.

rows.feature: Jump to a frame or time
rows.text: There's no Jump to window or typed seek.

rows.feature: Jump to the line's start or end
rows.where: Video › Go to start time of line, Go to end time of line

rows.feature: Video follows the selected line
rows.text: Chooses when to move and what to play after moving.

rows.feature: Toggle focus to the video slider
rows.text: No command moves the keyboard to the seek bar; step with the frame and keyframe commands in the Video menu instead.

rows.feature: Zoom and pan as in 3.5 (wheel zoom, middle-drag and Shift+wheel pan, pinch, reset)
rows.text: The plain wheel doesn't resize the video box, because the video fills its panel; each wheel's action is a setting and the legacy crop zoom is kept.
rows.where: Video › Zoom video, Reset zoom and pan; Settings › Video › View › Zoom and pan

rows.feature: Zoom to 50, 100 or 200%, zoom in and out by command
rows.text: Only Zoom video and Reset zoom and pan.

rows.feature: Aspect ratio: default, 4:3, 16:9, 2.35, custom
rows.text: A Taller–Wider stretch and Reset; no fixed ratios and no typed ratio.

rows.feature: Overscan mask
rows.text: There's no overscan or safe-area mask.

rows.feature: Copy the pointer's coordinates
Save or copy the frame: with subtitles, without, subtitles only on transparent
Detach video into its own window
rows.text: Every panel can float, and tabs can move to other windows, each with its own video.
rows.where: Panel ⋯ › Float; Document tab › Move tab to new window

rows.feature: Video details (with colour space and matrix)
Choose or cycle the subtitles renderer
rows.where: Settings › Video: libass, or VSFilterMod on Windows

rows.feature: Dummy video
rows.text: Sides up to 100000 px, an exact fraction frame rate, a 1080x1920 preset.

rows.feature: Resolution, LayoutRes and YCbCr matrix prompts on open; HDR and untagged warnings
rows.where: Prompts on opening video; each a row in Settings › Video

rows.feature: Subtitles drawn with the file's YCbCr matrix
AV1 video (dav1d)
YUV4MPEG (`.y4m`) video
rows.text: `.y4m` files open through FFMS2; pick All files in Open video, as its filter doesn't list them.

rows.feature: AviSynth scripts as video (Windows)
rows.text: Video opens through FFMS2 only; render the script to a lossless file first, and open that.

rows.feature: VapourSynth and BestSource providers (fork)
rows.text: Video opens through FFMS2 only, which covers seeking, and the official Keyframe generator plugin makes keyframes.

rows.feature: Keyframe generation (fork, VapourSynth)
rows.text: With the official **Keyframe generator** plugin (separate install).

rows.feature: Standard (crosshair) tool
rows.where: Video tool strip: Position pointer, Text positioning

rows.feature: Drag (`\move`)
rows.text: A move from one point on two frames.

rows.feature: Rotate Z, rotate XY
rows.text: Set angle from 2 points.

rows.feature: Scale
rows.text: Set scale by rectangle.

rows.feature: Rectangular clip
Vector clip: drag, line, Bézier, remove; modes on keys
rows.text: B-splines and separate points too, and a Vector drawing tool with shapes.
rows.where: Video tool strip; each mode bindable

rows.feature: Vector clip: freehand, freehand smooth, convert a segment, insert a point
rows.text: No freehand or convert mode; a point is inserted by right-click in the Line, Bézier and B-spline modes.

rows.feature: Vector clip coordinates with two decimals
Handle size setting
Perspective tool (fork)
rows.text: Perspective tracking from Power-Pin data.
rows.where: Video tool strip: Perspective; Video › Tracking › Apply Power-Pin data…

rows.feature: Align to video (fork `time/align`)
rows.text: Checks every frame, where Aegisub steps two.

rows.feature: Visual typesetting help page
rows.where: F1 over the video opens the guide's page

rows.feature: Styles manager: storages (catalogues), copy both ways, import from a script, sort, move
rows.text: Edit several styles at once, Add to all open files, Delete unused styles, and a Styles panel.

rows.feature: Style editor with preview
Border style 4 (opaque box per line)
rows.text: A three-way Border type that says which choice is libass-only.

rows.feature: Encoding -1 (detect text direction)
Styling assistant
rows.text: There's no window that steps through lines applying styles.

rows.feature: Fonts collector: check, copy to a folder or the subtitle's folder, zip
rows.text: The renderer checks which font answered each name, missing faces and glyphs; runs on all tabs; takes fonts from the MKV.

rows.feature: Fonts collector: symlink fonts to a folder
rows.text: Fonts attached to an MKV have no file, so they're copied; on Windows a link needs Developer Mode or a folder on the font's drive.
rows.where: Collect fonts › Link to a folder

rows.feature: Reload the renderer's fonts (fork `video/subtitles_provider/reload`)
rows.text: Fonts reload by themselves when the catalogue changes.

rows.feature: Resample resolution, from video, LayoutRes kept
rows.text: Adjust 3D rotations keeps rotated signs in shape.

rows.feature: Resample: margin offsets, add or remove borders, manual aspect
rows.text: The aspect ratio is Keep it or Stretch, with no margin offsets or borders.

rows.feature: Resample: change the YCbCr matrix
rows.text: Also offered when a video with another matrix opens, converting the colours of styles and colour tags.

rows.feature: Default style catalogue for new files
rows.text: File › New always starts with the built-in Default style; the catalogue setting covers conversions only.

rows.feature: Translation assistant (original shown, next, previous, insert original)
rows.text: Translation mode keeps original and translation side by side in the file, with an Original text panel, Paste all and Paste the selected text.
rows.where: Subtitles › Translation mode; View › Panels › Original text

rows.feature: Karaoke templater (kara-templater.lua, Karaoke template export filter)
rows.text: Built in, with a Template editor and live preview; the export filter is a Before export step in Export as.
rows.where: Automation › Apply karaoke template; View › Panels › Template editor

rows.feature: Automatic karaoke lead-in macro
Find, find next
rows.text: Find previous, a live match count, Find all.
rows.where: Edit › Find…, Find next, Find previous

rows.feature: Find and replace (fields, selected lines, regex, case)
rows.text: Across open tabs or a folder on disk, inside or outside tags, Replace N checked.

rows.feature: Select lines: by field, regex, case, dialogue or comments, set, add, subtract
rows.text: Then copy, cut, delete, move or comment them, in all tabs, and an Overlapping lines search.

rows.feature: Select lines: intersect with the selection, exact match
rows.text: The modes are Select, Add to selection and Deselect, and matching is "with" or "without" the text.

rows.feature: Spell checker (replace, ignore, add, language, skip comments and capitals)
rows.text: Several dictionaries at once for mixed-language lines, and a grammar check beside it.

rows.feature: Automation manager, reload scripts, reload autoload
rows.text: Each script runs in its own process, so a crash stops only that script; Repeat last run.
rows.where: Automation › Show panel, Refresh autoload scripts, Repeat last run

rows.feature: Macros in the Automation menu, submenus from `/`
Lua and MoonScript Automation 4 API, as in 3.5.1
`project_properties().timecodes_file`
Fork API: `gui.*`, `get_frame` with `getPixel` and `data()`, `get_audio_selection`, `set_status_text`, `line.extra`
Export filters from scripts (`register_filter`)
rows.text: A loaded script's filters are steps in Before export.

rows.feature: Macro descriptions, log levels 4 and 5
rows.where: Automation panel tooltips; Settings › Automation › Lua trace level (0–5)

rows.feature: Greyed-out invalid macros and their own undo points
rows.text: The reason shows under the greyed-out row and in the command palette, and macros that report themselves active get a check mark.

rows.feature: MoonScript 0.7.0
rows.text: MoonScript 0.5.0 is bundled.

rows.feature: 3.5 library fixes: `lfs.dir` raises the message, `include()` reports the real error
Built-in modules always load from the installation
Bundled macros: Clean Tags, Strip Tags, Add edgeblur, Make text fullwidth, Select overlaps
DependencyControl
rows.text: Bundled with its Toolbox and the usual libraries.

rows.feature: Options window
Hotkeys editor
rows.text: Shift+click any menu item to give it a key; conflicts shown as you press; Import settings… brings over Aegisub's hotkey.json.

rows.feature: Interface colours for each element (audio, grid, syntax, visual tools)
rows.text: Themes, accent colours and high-contrast colours only; theme plugins are planned to cover it.

rows.feature: Interface language
rows.text: 5 languages today (English, Korean, Polish, Tamil, Thai). More will come through community translation on HikariSub's own translation platform.

rows.feature: Display modes: full, video+subs, audio+subs, subs only
rows.text: Layouts (Editing, Timing, Translation, Typesetting, Karaoke) plus your own, floating panels.

rows.feature: New window
rows.text: Move a tab to another window; each window keeps its own video and comes back with the session.
rows.where: Document tab › Move tab to new window

rows.feature: Main toolbar
rows.text: No main toolbar, by owner decision.

rows.feature: Log window
Check for updates
rows.text: Signed updates that can install themselves.

rows.feature: About, exit
Help: contents, website, bug tracker
rows.text: Report an issue is a form inside the app.
rows.where: Help › User guide, Report an issue…

rows.feature: IRC channel link
rows.text: The Help menu has no chat link.

rows.feature: Export a copy in another format
rows.text: WebVTT, SBV, TTML, DFXP, srv3, MPL2 and TMPlayer, a report of what each line lost, lines by All, Selected or Shown.

rows.feature: Export or save as SSA
rows.text: SSA opens but is never written as SSA; every current player reads ASS.

rows.feature: Export to Adobe Encore, TranStation, MPEG-4 TTXT
rows.text: These formats are obsolete, so none is an export format.

rows.feature: Export to EBU STL
rows.text: EBU STL isn't an export format; it's planned as a plugin.

rows.feature: Export filters: Transform framerate, Fix styles, Clean tags, Karaoke template
rows.text: Also saves a list of steps as a recipe, for you or a Project, and reads the list Aegisub keeps in the file.

rows.feature: Export text encoding choice
rows.text: Offered for SRT, SBV, plain text, MicroDVD, MPL2 and TMPlayer, with a warning listing characters the encoding can't hold; WebVTT, TTML and srv3 stay UTF-8.

rows.feature: MicroDVD and SRT import settings (frame rate)
Autosave and Open autosaved subtitles
rows.text: The Home page offers the copies after a crash; a copy opens as a new "(recovered)" file.

rows.feature: Autosave interval you can set
rows.text: Autosave runs 20 seconds after a change; only the number of copies kept is a setting.

rows.feature: Automatic backup copy on save
rows.text: Saving keeps no backup copy (only Find's folder replace does).

rows.feature: Windows
rows.text: Windows 10 1809+ and 11, x64.

rows.feature: Linux
rows.text: x86_64, X11 and Wayland.

rows.feature: Runs on macOS (and its window menu commands)
rows.text: There's no macOS build, and none is planned for now.
